summary.headline: Horizon Industrial Parks Q1 FY27 revenue rose 23% YoY to INR200 crores, with EBITDA of INR161 crores (80% margin) and a net loss of INR12 crores.
summary.overview: Management's first earnings call after the August IPO, which raised INR4,250 crores of primary capital used for deleveraging to a proforma net debt of about INR2,500 crores at 30 June. Revenue was INR200 crores (+23% YoY) and EBITDA INR161 crores (+36% YoY). Management steered attention to a proforma cash PAT of INR116 crores, arguing the reported net loss is distorted by non-cash depreciation and pre-deleveraging interest. Leasing was 1.9 million sq ft across 13 transactions, with contracted revenue run rate at about INR967-970 crores.

financial_highlights.change: expected to fall 40-50 bps post deleveraging

segments.name: Large-format industrial and warehousing parks
segments.commentary: 29.5 million sq ft operational across 46 assets in 9 states and 10 markets; 26.9 mn sq ft on operational area, plus 2.4 mn sq ft pre-leased under construction. Yield on cost about 11-12%.

segments.name: In-city (urban mid-mile/last-mile) assets
segments.commentary: 17 assets across 7 cities, about 6-7 mn sq ft; rentals about 2.5-3x big-format; yield on cost 13-14% after CWC revenue share. Three mid-mile assets fully leased at INR65-70 per sq ft (as stated). First Pune (Pimpri) delivery targeted Q4 FY27.

segments.name: Value-added services (rooftop solar, worker accommodation, hospitality, skill centre)
segments.commentary: Rooftop solar about 38 MW, of which about 20 MW operational and 17-18 MW being operationalised. Worker accommodation of 6,000-7,000 beds under construction; target 5-10% of revenue in 4-5 years.

guidance_outlook: FY27 leasing target of 6.5 mn sq ft (about 30% growth vs last fiscal), with 4-4.5 mn sq ft of incremental leasing expected over the next 9 months.
FY27 completion target of 6 mn sq ft, taking operational area to about 34-35 mn sq ft by year-end at high-90s occupancy.
Net loss expected to turn to profit from Q2 or Q3 FY27 (management guidance on reported P&L).
Capex of INR1,500-2,000 crores over next 3 years, roughly one-third internal accruals and two-thirds incremental debt.
Target to double large-format park capacity over 4-5 years; in-city 6 mn sq ft over next 3 years.
Incremental capex yield on cost guided at 13-14%; in-city construction cost about INR4,500 per sq ft with rents guided at INR70-75 per sq ft (as stated).
capex_capacity: Land bank of about 30 mn sq ft is fully paid, with approvals and financing largely in place; 25 mn sq ft of large-park development remaining.
Build cycles are 9-12 months; 20-30% of development pre-leased, with a stock-in-trade of 1.6 mn sq ft across the operational network.

Pimpri (Pune) in-city multi-storey asset targeted for Q4 FY27 delivery; a Delhi High Court case challenging the tender for 13 in-city warehouses is sub judice, with management expecting large part delivery in 12-24 months.
Approximately 1 mn sq ft delivered in Q1; 5 mn sq ft of buildings to be delivered over the next 9 months.
demand_pricing: Re-leasing spreads of 12% in Q1 (on about 300,000 sq ft expiries), versus 12-15% historically, above the 5% contractual annual escalation; WALE about 7.1 years.
Industrial-segment leases at about INR29+ per sq ft versus about INR24 for bare-bone warehousing; blended in-place rent plus CAM about INR27.20 per sq ft.
High single-digit market rent growth in deeper markets (as stated).
Expiries of about 1.4 mn sq ft in the next 9 months and 2.2 mn sq ft next fiscal (about 13% of portfolio over 21 months).
Three-fourths of Q1 leasing came from industrial customers; industrial and manufacturing customers are close to half the portfolio. Over 120 customers; nine new customers onboarded in Q1.

qa_highlights.question: Does 25% volume growth plus 5% escalation imply about 30% revenue CAGR over 3-4 years?
qa_highlights.answer: Management described four growth engines: contractual escalations plus re-leasing spreads on 29.5 mn sq ft, 6 mn sq ft of large-park development, in-city expansion of about 2 mn sq ft a year, and value-added services at 5-10% of revenue. It did not confirm a 30% CAGR figure.

qa_highlights.question: How does the INR967 crore contracted run rate translate into reported EBITDA and timing?
qa_highlights.answer: About 80-85% sits on existing assets with nearly full 12-month revenue flow expected; the 2.4 mn sq ft pre-leased, under-construction area should contribute within 9-12 months. Further 4-4.5 mn sq ft of leases are expected over 9 months.

qa_highlights.question: What are the plans for leverage, capex and cost of debt?
qa_highlights.answer: Capex of INR1,500-2,000 crores over 3 years, funded one-third internally and two-thirds by debt. Cost of debt (about 8.2%) expected to fall 40-50 bps as ratings improve.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company expand beyond its 10 markets and pursue acquisitions?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it will explore Tier 1-minus/Tier 2 markets opportunistically (cited Nagpur, Goa, Nashik), focus on share gains in existing Tier 1 markets, and keep acquisitions (land parcels and consolidation of sub-scale platforms) central. No quantified annual addition target was given.

qa_highlights.question: What is the competitive intensity in institutional supply?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the market can absorb many more Horizon-scale players; Grade-A stock is under 500 mn sq ft nationally, and more than 90% of stock is fragmented or non-compliant.

qa_highlights.question: When will the reported P&L turn profitable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management guided that the P&L should turn black from Q2 or Q3 FY27 onwards.

risks_watch: Reported P&L: management guided the net loss (INR12 crores in Q1) to turn to profit from Q2 or Q3 FY27; the pro forma cash PAT of INR116 crores is unaudited and management-defined, so track reported PAT against that guidance.

Delivery execution: FY27 completion target of 6 mn sq ft and about 1 mn sq ft delivered in Q1; Pimpri in-city asset targeted for Q4 FY27, and 13 in-city warehouses face a sub judice Delhi High Court tender challenge with delivery expected in 12-24 months.
Leasing: FY27 target of 6.5 mn sq ft requires 4-4.5 mn sq ft of incremental leases over 9 months; about 1.4 mn sq ft expires in the next 9 months and 2.2 mn sq ft next fiscal.

Rent and re-leasing: Q1 re-leasing spread of 12% was on only about 300,000 sq ft of expiries; monitor whether spreads hold versus the 12-15% historical range and the high single-digit market rent growth claim.

Funding and cost of debt: capex of INR1,500-2,000 crores over 3 years (about two-thirds debt); current cost of debt about 8.2% with a 40-50 bps reduction expected post ratings upgrade, which is not yet confirmed.
key_quotes: Q1 has been our strongest ever quarter. We delivered revenue of INR200 crores, representing 23% year-on-year growth, EBITDA of INR161 crores while maintaining a very healthy EBITDA margin at 80%.
While we reported a net loss for the quarter of INR12 crores, this continues to be impacted by non -cash depreciation and interest expense.
That's sub judice, so I will not be able to comment much more on that. But we remain very confident on our position, and we are spearing ahead with our strategy and plan on those assets.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident and promotional throughout, repeatedly calling Q1 the strongest ever and steering attention to pro forma cash PAT over the reported net loss. It was noticeably evasive on the Blackstone exit and hold period, on quantifying acquisition or new-market targets, and on the Delhi High Court tender case, which it declined to discuss beyond calling it sub judice.
